When the voucher is claimed, a unique expiry date will be generated on every voucher, and the rebate will become invalid after the mentioned expiry date. The next day, User A will receive a rebate of 400 USDT instead of the full 500 USDT, and the remaining balance can be used for future trades."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If, instead, User A activates a 500 USDT Trading Fee Rebate Voucher (50% trade back), on the first day, the system records the same spot trading fee of $500. Since the rebate voucher offers a 50% trade back, he can only get 50% of the rebates. The remaining 300 USDT can be used for his future trades before expiry."}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"User A activates a 500 USDT Trading Fee Rebate Voucher (50% trade back) and he was referred to Binance, his referrer would receive part of the trading fees user A generated as commission. User A paid 100 USDT on his trades. And for instance, if the referral commission is 20%, the referrer will receive 20 USDT. The remaining trading fee will be 80 USDT. 40 USDT will be deducted from the Trading Fee Rebate Voucher balance, as this voucher offers a 50% trade back. The remaining balance of the Trading Fee Rebate Voucher will be 500 - 80×50% = 460 USDT. User A can use the remaining balance to cover their trading fees before the voucher expires."}]}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"If the trading fees from eligible transactions exceed the voucher’s balance, the rebate you receive will be limited to the remaining voucher balance, with the trade back percentage applied."},{"node":"element","tag":"ul","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"For example, User A activated a 100 USDT Trading Fee Rebate Voucher (50% trade back) for Spot trading last week, and the remaining voucher balance is now 40 USDT. After deducting the trading fee rebate on the following day, the vouchers’ balances will be:"},{"node":"element","tag":"ul","child":[{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Voucher A: 100 - (100 × 0.6) = 40 USDT remaining"}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"Voucher B: 80 USDT (unused)"}]}]}]},{"node":"element","tag":"li","child":[{"node":"text","text":"The next day, User A generated 200 USDT trading fees.
